parsed.summary: To get ready for a BTO launch next year, you should start the HFE application, gather required documents, and ensure you meet the basic eligibility criteria.

claims.text: First-timer couples must obtain an HFE (Housing Flat Eligibility) letter before they can apply for a BTO flat.
Log in to the HDB Flat Portal and start the HFE application as soon as possible, as processing can take several weeks.
Prepare the required documents for the HFE application, including NRICs, latest CPF contribution statements, recent payslips, and income tax notices for both applicants.
Check that both applicants are Singapore Citizens and have not previously owned any HDB flat or received any housing subsidy, as this is a key eligibility condition for first-timer couples.
Confirm that neither of you holds any private residential property in Singapore or overseas, as ownership of private property can affect HFE eligibility.
If you are planning to have children or are expecting, note that this does not affect HFE eligibility but may be relevant for future grant considerations.
Policy details such as processing times and document requirements can change; always verify the latest information on the official HDB website (hdb.gov.sg) or the HDB Flat Portal.
